Auth.codeSentRegister: Twohereje kode y'imibare 6 kuri {email}. Yandike hano kugira ngo urangize kwiyandikisha.
Auth.codeSentLogin: Konti yawe ntiremezwa. Twohereje kode y'imibare 6 kuri {email}. Yandike hano kugira ngo winjire.
Auth.codeExpired: Igihe cya kode cyarangiye. Kanda "Ohereza kode nshya" ubone indi.
Auth.verifiedSettingUp: Imeyili yemejwe! Turimo gutegura konti yawe...
Auth.resendFailed: Ntibyakunze kohereza kode nshya. Ongera ugerageze.
Auth.loginIntro: Injira urebe urugendo rwawe rwo gutwita na raporo z'ubuzima bwawe.
Auth.promoText: Gusuzuma ibimenyetso hashingiwe ku bimenyetso mpuruza bya OMS, gukurikirana gahunda yo kwipimisha inda, amazina y'abana n'ubuyobozi bwuzuye bwo kwita ku mubyeyi utwite, mu Kinyarwanda no mu Cyongereza.
Auth.registerIntro: Iyandikishe kuri MamaCare ubone ibikoresho byagenewe ubuzima bwawe n'ubw'umwana wawe.
Auth.passwordMin: Ijambo ry'ibanga rigomba kugira nibura inyuguti 8.
Auth.consent: Nemera <terms>Amabwiriza yo gukoresha</terms> na <privacy>Politiki y'ibanga</privacy>, kandi nemera ko MamaCare ibika kandi ikoresha amakuru y'ubuzima ntanga kugira ngo inyiteho.
Auth.registered: Kwiyandikisha byakunze! Turimo kukujyana ku rubuga rwawe...
Auth.forgotIntro: Andika imeyili ya konti yawe tukoherereze kode y'imibare 6 yo guhindura ijambo ry'ibanga.
Auth.codeSentReset: Niba hari konti ikoresha {email}, twayoherereje kode y'imibare 6.
Auth.passwordChanged: Ijambo ry'ibanga ryawe ryahinduwe. Ubu ushobora kwinjira ukoresheje irishya.
Auth.cannotReachServer: Ntitubashije kugera kuri seriveri ya MamaCare. Reba interineti yawe wongere ugerageze.

Symptoms.title: Wumva umeze ute?
Symptoms.intro: Sobanura ibimenyetso ufite mu magambo yawe, mu Kinyarwanda cyangwa mu Cyongereza. MamaCare ibigereranya n'ibimenyetso mpuruza bya OMS ku mubyeyi utwite, ikakubwira uko byihutirwa n'icyo ukwiye gukora.
Symptoms.emergency: Mu gihe cy'ibyago, ntutegereze: hamagara 912 cyangwa ujye ku kigo nderabuzima kikwegereye.
Symptoms.placeholder: Urugero: "Kuva mu gitondo mfite umutwe undya cyane kandi simbona neza"

bleeding.label: Kuva amaraso
bleeding.text: Mfite inda y'ibyumweru 24 kandi natangiye kuva amaraso mu gitsina muri iki gitondo.

headache.label: Umutwe no kutabona neza
headache.text: Mfite umutwe undya cyane udakira kandi simbona neza.

nausea.label: Isereri yo mu gitondo
nausea.text: Mu gitondo ngira isereri nkumva ndananiwe, ariko nta bubabare mfite.

levels.red: Byihutirwa: jya ku kigo nderabuzima ubu

Symptoms.safetyRule: Iki gisubizo cyatanzwe n'itegeko ry'umutekano rishingiye ku bimenyetso mpuruza bya OMS.
Symptoms.waitingText: Sobanura uko wiyumva, cyangwa ukande ku rugero rumwe.
Symptoms.disclaimer: Iri suzuma ritanga inama, si isuzumwa rya muganga. Buri gihe kurikiza inama z'umukozi w'ubuzima ukwitaho.

Danger.title: Ibimenyetso mpuruza: genda ubu
Danger.intro: Niba ufite kimwe muri ibi bimenyetso, jya ku kigo nderabuzima kikwegereye ako kanya. Ntutegereze gahunda yawe ikurikira.
pregnancy: Umutwe ukabije, kutabona neza cyangwa kubona utudomo
Amazi ava cyangwa ameneka mbere yo kujya ku nda
Umwana anyeganyega gake kurusha uko bisanzwe, cyangwa ntiyinyeganyeze
Kubyimba mu maso no ku biganza
Kuruka cyane ku buryo udashobora kugumana ibyo unywa
Danger.getHelpTitle: Igihe cyo gushaka ubufasha uyu munsi
Danger.getHelpIntro: Bonana n'umukozi w'ubuzima uwo munsi nyine niba ubonye kimwe muri ibi. Ku mwana w'uruhinja, ntutegereze.
baby: Ntonka, cyangwa asinziriye cyane ku buryo adakanguka ngo yonke
Ibitambaro (pampers) bitose bike kurusha uko bikwiye, cyangwa inkari zijimye
Uruhu cyangwa amaso by'umuhondo, cyane cyane ku munsi wa mbere cyangwa mu biganza no mu birenge
Ahumeka vuba, aruka ibintu byose, cyangwa agagara
breastfeedingMother: Umuriro hamwe n'igice cy'ibere gitukura, gishyushye kandi kibabaza
Amashyira cyangwa amaraso biva ku imoko
Ububabare budakira nyuma yo gukosora uko umwana yonka
Kumva wihebye cyane, ufite ubwoba bwinshi, cyangwa utabasha kwihanganira ibihe urimo
postpartum: Kuva amaraso menshi yuzura ibitambaro vuba
Umuriro, umutwe ukabije, kubabara mu gatuza, cyangwa guhumeka bigoye
Agahinda kadashira, kwiheba, cyangwa ibitekerezo byo kwigirira nabi
